```{r setup, include=FALSE}
lapply(Packages, library, character.only=TRUE)
```


```{r batch_abundance_comparison}

# ── 1. Tag each metabolite with its detection group ──────────────────────────
metabolite_abundance_tagged <- metabolite_abundance %>%
  left_join(
    combined_peak_area %>% select(Name, Detected_Batch1, Detected_Batch2, Detected_Both),
    by = "Name"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Detection_Group = case_when(
      Detected_Both                          ~ "Both Batches",
      Detected_Batch1 & !Detected_Batch2    ~ "Batch 1 Only",
      Detected_Batch2 & !Detected_Batch1    ~ "Batch 2 Only",
      TRUE                                   ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    Detection_Group = factor(Detection_Group,
                             levels = c("Both Batches", "Batch 1 Only", "Batch 2 Only"))
  )

# ── 2. Top 20 per detection group (bar charts) ───────────────────────────────
n_top <- 20

plot_batch_top_bar <- function(data, group_label, color) {
  top <- data %>%
    filter(Detection_Group == group_label) %>%
    slice_max(mean_intensity, n = n_top) %>%
    mutate(Name = fct_reorder(Name, mean_intensity))
  
  ggplot(top, aes(x = mean_intensity, y = Name)) +
    geom_col(fill = color, color = "white", width = 0.7) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_scientific()) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Top ", n_top, " Most Abundant Metabolites — ", group_label),
      x = "Mean Intensity",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
}

p_both   <- plot_batch_top_bar(metabolite_abundance_tagged, "Both Batches", "#2E86AB")
p_batch1 <- plot_batch_top_bar(metabolite_abundance_tagged, "Batch 1 Only", "#E84855")
p_batch2 <- plot_batch_top_bar(metabolite_abundance_tagged, "Batch 2 Only", "#F4A261")

save_dual_format(p_both,   "combined clean top_abundant_both_batches",   png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path)
save_dual_format(p_batch1, "combined clean top_abundant_batch1_only",    png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path)
save_dual_format(p_batch2, "combined clean top_abundant_batch2_only",    png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path)

print(p_both)
print(p_batch1)
print(p_batch2)

# ── 3. Side-by-side comparison of top 20 overall, colored by detection group ─
top20_overall <- metabolite_abundance_tagged %>%
  slice_max(mean_intensity, n = 20) %>%
  mutate(Name = fct_reorder(Name, mean_intensity))

batch_palette <- c("Both Batches"  = "#2E86AB",
                   "Batch 1 Only"  = "#E84855",
                   "Batch 2 Only"  = "#F4A261")

p_top20_colored <- ggplot(top20_overall, aes(x = mean_intensity, y = Name,
                                              fill = Detection_Group)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = batch_palette) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_scientific()) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 20 Most Abundant Metabolites (Overall) — Colored by Batch Detection",
    x = "Mean Intensity",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Detected In"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "bottom")

save_dual_format(p_top20_colored, "combined clean top20_colored_by_batch", png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path)
print(p_top20_colored)

# ── 4. Detection group composition summary ───────────────────────────────────
detection_summary <- metabolite_abundance_tagged %>%
  count(Detection_Group) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1))

p_detection_donut <- ggplot(detection_summary, aes(x = 2, y = n, fill = Detection_Group)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", width = 1) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  xlim(0.5, 2.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = batch_palette) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Detection_Group, "\n", n, " (", pct, "%)")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3.5) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Metabolite Composition by Batch Detection") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "none")

save_dual_format(p_detection_donut, "combined clean detection_group_composition", png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path)
print(p_detection_donut)

# ── 5. Rank comparison: where do batch-specific metabolites fall in overall rank? ─
rank_comparison <- metabolite_abundance_tagged %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_intensity)) %>%
  mutate(Overall_Rank = row_number())

p_rank_density <- ggplot(rank_comparison, aes(x = Overall_Rank, fill = Detection_Group,
                                               color = Detection_Group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = batch_palette) +
  scale_color_manual(values = batch_palette) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Overall Abundance Ranks by Batch Detection Group",
    subtitle = "Left = more abundant; curves peaking left = group skews toward top ranks",
    x = "Overall Abundance Rank",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Detected In",
    color = "Detected In"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title    = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey40"),
        legend.position = "bottom")

save_dual_format(p_rank_density, "combined clean rank_density_by_batch", png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path)
print(p_rank_density)
```

## Annotation Completeness
```{r annotation_completeness}
# Define annotation categories to check
annotation_categories <- c("Super.Class", "Class", "Sub.Class", "Pathways")

# Calculate missingness per category for annotated metabolites only
annotation_completeness <- combined_compound_annotation %>%
  filter(Compound.ID %in% combined_peak_area$Name) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(annotation_categories),
                   list(
                     n_missing  = ~sum(is.na(.) | . == ""),
                     n_present  = ~sum(!is.na(.) & . != ""),
                     pct_missing = ~round(100 * mean(is.na(.) | . == ""), 1)
                   ),
                   .names = "{.col}__{.fn}")) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(),
               names_to  = c("Category", ".value"),
               names_sep = "__") %>%
  mutate(Total = n_missing + n_present,
         Category = factor(Category, levels = annotation_categories))

# Print summary table
cat("\n=== ANNOTATION COMPLETENESS SUMMARY ===\n")
print(annotation_completeness %>%
        select(Category, n_present, n_missing, Total, pct_missing) %>%
        rename("Annotated" = n_present, "Missing" = n_missing,
               "% Missing" = pct_missing))

# Stacked bar: annotated vs missing per category
annotation_completeness_long <- annotation_completeness %>%
  select(Category, n_present, n_missing) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(n_present, n_missing),
               names_to  = "Status",
               values_to = "Count") %>%
  mutate(Status = recode(Status,
                         "n_present" = "Annotated",
                         "n_missing" = "Missing"))

p_annotation_completeness <- ggplot(annotation_completeness_long,
                                    aes(x = Category, y = Count, fill = Status)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Count),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            color = "white", size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Annotated" = "#2E86AB", "Missing" = "#E84855")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "combined clean Annotation Completeness by Category",
       x = "Annotation Category",
       y = "Number of Metabolites",
       fill = "Status") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

save_dual_format(p_annotation_completeness, "combined clean annotation_completeness",
                 png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path)
print(p_annotation_completeness)

# Percent-missing bar for a cleaner at-a-glance view
p_annotation_pct_missing <- ggplot(annotation_completeness,
                                   aes(x = Category, y = pct_missing, fill = Category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(pct_missing, "%")),
            vjust = -0.4, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 105), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "combined clean % Metabolites Missing Annotation by Category",
       x = "Annotation Category",
       y = "% Missing") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

save_dual_format(p_annotation_pct_missing, "combined clean annotation_pct_missing",
                 png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path)
print(p_annotation_pct_missing)
```

## PCA

### Sample PCA

```{r PCA_One, echo = TRUE}
# PCA of sample variation
# Prepare data for PCA (samples as rows, metabolites as columns)
samples_matrix <- combined_peak_area %>%
  select(starts_with("Sample")) %>%
  t()

# 1/5th min value imputation
samples_matrix <- apply(samples_matrix, 2, min_value_impute)

# Perform PCA
pca_samples <- prcomp(samples_matrix, scale. = TRUE)

# Convert PCA results to data frame and add Sample labels
sample_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_samples$x)
sample_scores$Sample <- rownames(sample_scores)

# Merge sample scores with metadata
sample_scores <- sample_scores %>%
  left_join(combined_sample_metadata, by = "Sample")

# Calculate variance explained
var_explained_samples <- pca_samples$sdev^2 / sum(pca_samples$sdev^2) * 100

# Create Elbow Plot
elbow_data <- data.frame(
  PC = 1:length(var_explained_samples),
  VarExp = var_explained_samples
)

sample_elbow <- ggplot(elbow_data, aes(x = PC, y = VarExp)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Principal Component",
       y = "Variance Explained (%)",
       title = "Scree Plot of PCA Variance Explained by Samples") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

save_dual_format(sample_elbow, "sample_elbow", png_path = png_path, svg_path =  svg_path)
print(sample_elbow)

# Plot PCA for samples
sample_pca <- ggplot(sample_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = Sample)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Sample), size = 3) +
  geom_text(vjust = -1, hjust = -0.1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[1]),
       y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[2]), title = "PCA of Sample Variation")

save_dual_format(sample_pca, "sample_pca", png_path = png_path, svg_path =  svg_path)
print(sample_pca)
# Sex PCA
sample_pca1x2_sex <- ggplot(sample_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Sex, label = Sample)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3, max.overlaps = 10) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[1]),
       y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[2]),
       title = "Sample PCA by Sex") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("F" = "#FF69B4", "M" = "#4169E1")) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

save_dual_format(sample_pca1x2_sex, "sample_pca1x2_sex", png_path = png_path, svg_path =  svg_path)
print(sample_pca1x2_sex)

sample_pca2x3_sex <- ggplot(sample_scores, aes(x = PC2, y = PC3, color = Sex, label = Sample)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3, max.overlaps = 10) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[2]),
       y = sprintf("PC3 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[3]),
       title = "Sample PCA by Sex") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("F" = "#FF69B4", "M" = "#4169E1")) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

save_dual_format(sample_pca2x3_sex, "sample_pca2x3_sex", png_path = png_path, svg_path =  svg_path)
print(sample_pca2x3_sex)

# GW PCA
sample_pca1x2_gw <- ggplot(sample_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = GW, label = Sample)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3, max.overlaps = 10) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[1]),
       y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[2]),

save_dual_format(sample_pca1x2_gw, "sample_pca1x2_gw", png_path = png_path, svg_path =  svg_path)
print(sample_pca1x2_gw)

sample_pca2x3_gw <- ggplot(sample_scores, aes(x = PC2, y = PC3, color = GW, label = Sample)) +
```

### Metabolite PCA
```{r pca_two}
# PCA of metabolite variation
# Prepare data for PCA (metabolites as rows, samples as columns)
metabolites_matrix <- combined_peak_area %>%
  select(starts_with("Sample"))

metabolites_matrix <- apply(metabolites_matrix, 2, min_value_impute)

# Perform PCA
pca_metabolites <- prcomp(metabolites_matrix, scale. = TRUE)

# Filter annotation to only names from batch2 (more samples)

combined_compound_annotation = combined_compound_annotation %>% arrange(desc(Batch)) %>%  # Sort in descending order of Batch
  distinct(Name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% # Keep the first unique row for Name
 arrange(Name) # Optional: Sort the final result by Name

# ensure there are only annotations in peak_area
compounds_in_peak <- unique(combined_peak_area$Name)

combined_compound_annotation <- combined_compound_annotation %>%
  filter(Name %in% compounds_in_peak)

# Convert PCA results to data frame and add metabolite labels
metabolite_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_metabolites$x)
metabolite_scores$Name <- combined_compound_annotation$Name
metabolite_scores$Class <- combined_compound_annotation$Class
metabolite_scores$Sub.Class <- combined_compound_annotation$Sub.Class
metabolite_scores$Super.Class <- combined_compound_annotation$Super.Class

# Calculate variance explained
var_explained_metabolites <- pca_metabolites$sdev^2 / sum(pca_metabolites$sdev^2) * 100

# Create Elbow Plot
elbow_data <- data.frame(
  PC = 1:length(var_explained_metabolites),
  VarExp = var_explained_metabolites
)

metabolite_elbow <- ggplot(elbow_data, aes(x = PC, y = VarExp)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Principal Component",
       y = "Variance Explained (%)",
       title = "Scree Plot of PCA Variance Explained by Metabolites") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

save_dual_format(metabolite_elbow, "metabolite_elbow", png_path = png_path, svg_path =  svg_path)
print(metabolite_elbow)

# Calculate distance from origin for each metabolite
metabolite_scores <- metabolite_scores %>%
  mutate(distance = sqrt(PC1^2 + PC2^2))

# Define a threshold for labeling outliers.
# This threshold can be adjusted based on the spread of your data.
threshold <- quantile(metabolite_scores$distance, 0.99)

# Create a logical column to indicate if the metabolite is an outlier
metabolite_scores <- metabolite_scores %>%
  mutate(is_outlier = distance > threshold)

# Plot PCA for metabolites with outlier labels
metabolite_pca1x2 <- ggplot(metabolite_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is_outlier, Name, "")), vjust = -1, hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_metabolites[1]),
       y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_metabolites[2]), 
       title = "PCA of Metabolite Variation") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

save_dual_format(metabolite_pca1x2, "metabolite_pca1x2", png_path = png_path, svg_path =  svg_path)
print(metabolite_pca1x2)
```
